articles.title: Still tapped in. Still moving forward.
articles.summary: Trae Tha Truth and Mozzy reconnect on Still Tapped In, a 12-track collaboration that brings their shared perspective back to the record.
articles.body:
Trae Tha Truth and Mozzy have released Still Tapped In. The Source reported the release on September 25, 2026, describing a 12-track project grounded in perseverance, faith and personal experience.

The collaboration includes appearances from Kalan.FrFr and Killa Twan. Read Shawn Grant’s report for the release details and track discussion.

articles.title: Showing up, wherever the need is.
articles.summary: Food, supplies and hands-on help: a dated report follows Trae’s relief work with storm-hit communities in northwest Indiana.
articles.body:
HOT 97 reported on August 24, 2026 that Trae Tha Truth traveled to northwest Indiana to assist communities recovering from severe storms. The report describes work alongside Operation BBQ Relief, including meals and help clearing debris.

The coverage follows an effort that reached several communities and expanded into Gary. The original report includes local perspectives on the response.

articles.title: A week for Houston. A tradition that keeps growing.
articles.summary: The 2026 Trae Day calendar brought another week of community events to Houston, with service at the center.
articles.body:
Defender Network’s July 2026 coverage looked at Trae Day’s community tradition and the July 16–22 event week. The report describes free resources and family activities built around giving back.

This is a recap of the 2026 celebration, not an announcement of future dates. Visit the original reporting for the calendar and interview.
